title: Data Engineer
content: <h2>About the role</h2><p>Example Freight is looking for a Data Engineer to design and run our batch and streaming pipelines.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>Python and SQL</li><li>Airflow and dbt</li><li>Experience with AWS data services</li></ul><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Own the ETL jobs that feed our pricing and routing models</li><li>Partner with analysts on data quality and documentation</li></ul>
